differences: The paper lists Experiment 2's Baseline as 10 trials and Ramp as 20; the trial numbers in the shared data and the experiment code give 20 Baseline and 30 Ramp trials (with the last 10 Baseline trials as the reference).
Trials removed in Experiment 2 (paper: mean 1.53%, SD 1.65%, range 0-4.76%) cannot be recounted, because Transfer1 formants were shared only as means.

Numbers that differ from the paper here and equally in the authors' own analysis objects in the shared R workspaces, so most likely typing slips in the paper: Experiment 1 SE of F1 change for the /ɪ/-shift 2.57 (paper 2.56); Experiment 1 Washout, 95% of speakers with a more positive F1 change for the /ɪ/-shift (paper 90%; one speaker's difference is +0.9 mel); Experiment 2 Washout, 14 of the 15 speakers of the F2 analysis with a more negative F2 change for the /ɪ/-shift (paper: all); Table 1 mean F2 perturbation of the F2 adapters 53.90 mel (paper 58.90); SE of F2 transfer for 'head' in bedhead 2.53 (paper 2.46) and for novel syllables 1.45 and 1.20 (the paper prints 1.51 and 1.54, the F1 values).
